name: Launcher shortcuts and App Intents
plain: Apps add quick actions to the icon menu and expose actions to voice and automation.
meaning: A long press on the icon shows a few actions; iOS App Intents also let Siri, Spotlight and Shortcuts run app actions. This puts app features into system surfaces.

android.persistence: Dynamic shortcuts reset on data clear; pinned shortcuts need user consent
android.api_surface: ShortcutManager (dynamic, static, pinned); Capabilities for assistant
android.note: Launcher shows about 4 to 5 shortcuts; per activity limit from getMaxShortcutCountPerActivity (typically 15)

ios.permission: None; Siri requires usage description for SiriKit
ios.api_surface: App Intents, SiriKit, UIApplicationShortcutItem (quick actions, iOS 9, up to 4 shown)
ios.note: Home Screen quick actions show at most 4 items (docs, from memory)

limits.headline: Can add quick actions to the icon menu, and offer actions to voice and automation
limits.user_action: You long press the app icon, or use Siri and Shortcuts suggestions
can: Show about 4 or 5 quick actions when you long press the icon
Offer Siri and Shortcuts suggestions on iPhone
Add up to about 15 shortcuts per screen of the app on Android
cannot: Show more than about 4 on iPhone's Home Screen menu
Run an action without you tapping it
Add shortcuts on Android before version 7.1
limits.differs: Android launchers show about 4 or 5 shortcuts. iPhone Home Screen quick actions show at most 4.

story.what_it_is: Quick actions on an app's icon menu and in voice and automation.

marketing.name: App shortcuts
marketing.pitch: Google lets apps add quick actions to the launcher icon menu.

marketing.name: App Intents
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps share actions to Siri, Spotlight and Shortcuts.

story.for_you: You press and hold an app icon and see quick choices like New message or Start run. Siri may also suggest actions at the right time.
story.for_makers: Makers get their best features closer to the home screen. A shortcut saves a tap and raises daily use.

use_cases.example: A long press on a chat app shows New message and Scan code.
A fitness icon offers Start workout.
A maps app offers Go home or Go to work.
A music app offers Play shuffle.
A notes app offers New note.
A bank app offers Pay or Deposit a check.
A game offers Continue or Daily reward.

story.android_note: The launcher shows about 4 to 5 shortcuts per app.
story.ios_note: Home screen quick actions show up to 4 items.
